reponse:
We’re **still aiming for December 1, but it’s conditional on Fernhill changing its SAML signing algorithm**. The contractual scope covers both login flows, just-in-time provisioning with Viewer as the default role, and a “Require SSO” setting that disables password login for Fernhill users [2].

What’s left:
- Fernhill’s IdP currently signs assertions with RSA-SHA1, so **IdP-initiated login works on staging but SP-initiated login fails**. Their change board meets November 24; if approved, the switch to RSA-SHA256 happens that evening [1][2].
- A joint end-to-end test is scheduled for **November 25 at 16:00 Tel Aviv / 14:00 London** [1].
- We’ve ruled out temporarily accepting SHA-1. If Fernhill’s board doesn’t approve the change on November 24, Sam will tell them that day that December 1 is at risk [8].
- The admin SSO page is on staging; its copy still needs Priya’s review. I don’t see confirmation yet of the final production rollout [2].
